t: These track are designed to be used to create or breakdown trains of carts. They must be powered by redstone to function. Right clicking on a coupler track will change it to decoupler mode and vice versa.
此类轨道专为编组或解编列车而设计，必须由红石充能才能运作。右键点击耦合轨道可切换其至解耦模式，反之亦然。

Coupler Tracks can be chained to linkup an entire Train when combined with a Train Detector.$(br)Coupler tracks have an additional mode called Auto-Coupling which can be configured with a crowbar. This sets a cart to couple with the next cart it collides with.
耦合轨道可串联使用，配合列车探测器即可完整连接整列列车。$(br)耦合轨道另有一种“自动耦合”模式，可通过撬棍配置。启用后，矿车将自动与前方碰撞到的第一辆矿车连接。
